definitions.W_s: consecutive-wrong-decision duration: per (sat,dst) stream and per flip decision at t0, W = t1 - t0 with t1 the next later NON-flip decision of that stream; censored at the horizon. NOT packet queueing time
definitions.a_fresh_rule: policy re-applied with truth-substituted J: geometry -> recorded used-state top among legal candidates; greedy/_ewma/_legacy -> argmin J_truth; hysteresis -> recorded last_direction if J_truth[last] <= min + recorded eta; sticky -> recorded sticky_keep direction when the hold fired, else argmin; softmin -> recorded uniform re-sampled through the truth-cost softmax
definitions.action_entropy_bits: mean Shannon entropy of ta_audit.state_policy.selection.probabilities (or selection.entropy); n/a for policies whose audit exposes no probabilities (all but queue_softmin today)
definitions.ctrl_share: occupied.ctrl_isl_s / stop_time_s (the ledger's authoritative control ISL occupancy).  link_service_windows carry no kind=='ctrl' marker, so the window-sum variant is not available
definitions.evaluable_subset: kind=='forward' AND >=2 legal candidates AND >=2 candidates with a usable truth row AND the chosen candidate itself has a usable truth row; every flip/regret/W/Gamma statistic is computed on it
definitions.flip_not_claiming: flip is a truth-substituted re-ranking of the SAME decision row; it is NOT a re-simulated counterfactual and must not be reported as the causal consequence of replaying branch A instead of branch B
definitions.gamma: |d(Q_a/rate_a)/dt - d(Q_b/rate_b)/dt| * tau / m_used over the used-state top-1/top-2 pair; slope from a local linear fit over +-0.25 s of the probe truth series at the decision target instant
definitions.j_truth_geometry: j_used_s (no state term; flip/regret are 0 by construction)
definitions.j_truth_queue_aware: j_used_s - resource_work_used_s + truth.work_ahead_bits / service_rate_bps (probe.service_rate_bps preferred, then the score's)
definitions.near_tie_proxy: fraction of decisions with a used-state margin below eps; this is the behavioural 'small score perturbation -> action divergence' proxy, not a mathematical sensitivity
definitions.paired_e2e: cells sharing family+regime+sync_ms+seed also share one trace, so packet ids align; only packets DELIVERED in BOTH cells are paired, delta = policy - baseline
definitions.response_sensitivity_axes: BEHAVIOURAL PROXIES (switch rate, mean run length, flip, entropy, near-tie fraction); not a strict mathematical sensitivity of J
definitions.run_length: number of consecutive same-chosen multi-candidate decisions inside one (sat,dst) stream
definitions.sticky_keep_rate: fraction of decisions whose state_policy audit says selection.rule == 'sticky_keep' (P5); n/a when the audit has no sticky fields
definitions.switch_rate: fraction of consecutive multi-candidate decisions inside one (sat,dst) stream whose chosen direction changed
definitions.tau_s: t_commit - used_state[chosen].measured_at; gen_to_recv = received_at - measured_at; recv_to_decision = t_commit - received_at
definitions.tie_break: (J, index in the recorded candidate/legal order, direction name); fallback candidates rank after every fully-known candidate
definitions.truth_filter: target_probe rows with identity_source=="used_state" AND probe generation == decision used_state[direction].generation AND finite truth.work_ahead_bits AND a positive service rate
definitions.util_busy: per ISL link: sum(window.end-window.start for stage=='isl') / stop_time from link_service_windows; max/p95 over links that served data.  Static topology in these cells, so no availability correction

freshness_stability.note: delta = fast sync (smaller advertisement interval) - slow sync, same family/regime/policy/seed, then mean over seeds; paired by construction, no re-simulation.

metrics_not_in_evidence: action entropy: only queue_softmin audits expose selection.probabilities/entropy
sticky keep/override: only queue_greedy_sticky audits expose them
path stretch: no shortest-path baseline in the evidence (hops only)
window-summed control service time: link_service_windows carry no kind=='ctrl' marker, so occupied.ctrl_isl_s / stop_time is used
control packet delay: control.instances[3] is an absolute received_at, so advertisement age is taken from the probe (state_received_at_s - state_measured_at_s)
Gamma needs >=3 truth samples inside +-0.25 s on BOTH resources
gaps.note: an empty list means the metric is available for every cell; entries are cell ids

identity_checks.note: empty lists mean seed replicates are independent (distinct traces) and one seed maps to exactly one trace; shared config identity is only a defect when the cells are meant to differ

response_sensitivity.note: BEHAVIOURAL PROXIES (switch rate, mean run length, flip, entropy, near-tie fraction); not a strict mathematical sensitivity of J
